title: MZ Looking for a Tileset That Matches them classic SNES vibes

posts.author: RaineDesidia
posts.body:
As the title implies, I'm just trying to find or get recommended a tileset that matches the vibes of some classic SNES JRPGs [FF4, FF5, FF6, Chrono Trigger, etc].
Main reason I'm asking is because I wanna make sure that I find one that is human made, with no generative AI involved [ the machines], but its getting really hard to tell the difference these days.
I've heard of something called Time Fantasy,  which was definitely made way before Gen AI, but idk if its been particularly overused like the RTP.
Any recommendations?

posts.author: Nirriti
posts.body:
Marumugi
on Itch does
(and still works on)
an excellent set of assets, just for that cause. Thats a starting point, at least. If you have a knack for art, use it as a trampoline to make your own project
(and asset)
. Youll learn quite a bit. I know its not exactly FF4~6 SNES in looks, but its pretty damn good
(if not the best)
of whats purchasable out there.
Thats what I did for the NES pack. I trashed all of his town NPCs
(sorry Marumugi)
and made all of them on my own instead (in ACTUAL FF style). Same for SV party characters... All the icons, system sheets... Sort out the junk. Remove what you dont like
(you wont have much left if youre minimally critical).
Theres free goodies out there too. Take some here and there, make your own as well
(ideally A LOT).
Sort them according to your needs and biases. Its a lot of work, but its worth it. <3

posts.body:
Vermin said:
I would add to this by saying if you're going to modify/create, the color palette you use will matter a great deal in getting the retro look you want.
Click to expand...
Thats true. On one hand, it makes choosing colors much simpler for you
(ex: monster recolors).
At the same time, it also limits the palettes you get access to
(and since most will respect said rule, it risk looking all the same).
I purposefully broke said rule, on my end. I want ALL the colors. Sometimes theres a specific palette I have in mind for a character... Trade-offs, basically.
